Maximum recalculations per waypoint afte: Maximum recalculations per waypoint after getting stuck or navigation failing to start. Default: 3. After retries fail, try a different movement path via nearby intermediate points to the same waypoint. The gathering route and target stay unchanged. Stop if no usable detour remains. 0 tries detours immediately.
Navigation retries exhausted. Trying an: Navigation retries exhausted. Trying an alternative movement path to the same waypoint.
No alternative movement path is availabl: No alternative movement path is available. Gathering has stopped at the current waypoint.
Choose walking, riding or flying from th: Choose walking, riding or flying from the distance to each new target. Default thresholds: 20 and 40 yalms. Movement mode is fixed for that leg. Mounting or takeoff failures fall back to walking or ground riding. Legacy waypoint movement settings are ignored.
Optimizes independent gathering stops wh: Optimizes independent gathering stops when starting a full route. Waits and route jumps keep their order. Saved routes are unchanged. Distance estimates use straight lines; vnavmesh handles obstacles during navigation.
After this many seconds without movement: After this many seconds without movement, try jumping while navigation continues. If horizontal movement stays below 0.5 yalms for 3 seconds, recalculate the path and use detours after the retry limit. Default: 10 seconds; 0 disables detection. Pauses, gathering and mounting do not count.
Stop only when every material currently: Stop only when every material currently unlocked for this gathering node is at its carrying limit. Materials locked by island progression or uncrafted tools are excluded. Continue if any available material has room. Unknown nodes do not trigger a stop.
Gathering stopped: all unlocked material: Gathering stopped: all unlocked materials at the current node are at capacity.
